evidence.title: approvals-ui: approval workflow components for React Flow

name: approvals-ui
summary: shadcn registry of React Flow components for approval workflows: quorum gates, thresholds, policy lint and human-gated editing.
description: Copy-paste components for the approval workflow screen: a workflow canvas that renders policy JSON as a laid-out graph of approval and terminal nodes, a validation panel running deterministic lint (segregation of duties, single approver above threshold), and a plain-language edit panel where a human reviews each proposed change as a diff before it lands. Installed with the shadcn CLI; includes a headless Zod policy core.
contains: 6 items: workflow canvas, approval node, terminal node, validation panel, plain-language edit panel, core
install with one shadcn CLI command or a namespaced registry
policy lint with 10 error rules and 7 warning rules, incl. segregation of duties
headless Zod policy model: a DAG of steps with guards
